name: Anancus

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Large or smaller, foot, DC 25 basic Reflex save

---

items.name: Tusk Sweep
items.text:
The anancus sweeps its long tusks back and forth, dealing 4d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone, who must make a DC 27 basic Reflex save save.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is knocked prone, and is pushed 5 feet away from the anancus.

text: The anancus is an ancient species of elephant with unusually long tusks and a trunk shorter than its more modern cousins.
